record.name: articuler.ai
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Articuler.ai helps you find the right people to meet at events.
Instead of scrolling through attendee lists or collecting random contacts, Articuler.ai shows you event matches based on your goals, profile, and professional context. See why someone is relevant, review shared connection points, and send a Connect Request when there is a strong fit.
Your contact information stays private until both people accept. When a request is accepted, Articuler.ai turns the match into a real connection you can follow up with after the event.
Use Articuler.ai to:
Discover relevant attendees at events
Re-rank matches around what you want to find
Understand why each person may be worth meeting
Send consent-based Connect Requests
Manage incoming and outgoing requests
Keep accepted event contacts in one place
Articuler.ai is built for focused, high-trust networking before, during, and after events.


【Auto-Renewal Subscription Terms】
1. Subscription Services:
a) Articuler Pro Continuous Monthly Subscription (1 Month)
b) Articuler Pro Continuous Annual Subscription (12 Months)
2. Pricing:
a) Articuler Pro Monthly: $25.00 / month
b) Articuler Pro Annually: $240.00 / year
c) Per Event Access: $15.00 / event (Note: This is a one-time purchase, not an auto-renewing subscription)
3. Payment:
Payment will be charged to your Apple iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
4. Auto-Renewal:
Your Apple iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Upon a successful deduction, your subscription will automatically be extended for one additional cycle.
5. Cancellation:
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time. To do so, open "Settings" on your Apple device --> tap your name/Apple ID --> tap "Subscriptions" --> select "Articuler" to manage your auto-renewal settings. To avoid being charged for the next cycle, please ensure you cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the current billing period ends.
6. Service Agreements:
a) Terms of Service: https://static.articuler.ai/user-service/terms_of_service.html
b) Privacy Policy: https://static.articuler.ai/user-service/privacy_policy.html
c) EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

record.name: Blind: Anonymous Work Network
record.offering: News app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Blind is the world’s largest anonymous professional network, with more than 12 million verified members sharing what’s really happening at work.

Layoffs. Reorgs. Hiring freezes. Return-to-office mandates. Salary changes. Leadership drama. Company rumors. Career advice.

From Google and JPMorgan to leading AI companies and emerging startups, get firsthand workplace news, conversations and perspectives from the people closest to them.
NO WORK EMAIL? NO PROBLEM.

Verify with work email, Linkedin or your work history to gain full access to company channels, private lounges and more. Sign on with a personal email to get read only access to public channels.


TALK ABOUT WORK ANONYMOUSLY

Talk openly about the things you can’t always say at work. Compare notes with coworkers, share what’s happening inside your company and get candid advice from people who understand your world of work.
Blind is built for anonymous workplace conversations, so you can speak freely without putting your real name on your posts. 

SEE WHAT’S HAPPENING AT WORK

When layoffs, reorganizations, leadership changes and major company news break, employees come to Blind to share what they’re seeing and hearing in real time.
Join discussions across thousands of companies and industries about:

• Layoffs, hiring and reorganizations
• Leadership and RTO changes
• Salaries, bonuses and benefits
• Promotions and performance reviews
• Company culture and management
• Interviews, offers and referrals
• Industry and workplace trends

KNOW YOUR WORTH

Explore salary data by role, company, location and experience. Compare compensation, prepare for negotiations and make better-informed career decisions.

MAKE YOUR NEXT CAREER MOVE

Explore jobs and learn what it’s really like to work somewhere before you apply or accept.
Read company reviews and get interview, offer and referral advice from people who have been through the hiring process.

FIND YOUR COMMUNITY

Explore communities around your company, industry, role and interests. Ask questions, exchange advice and connect with people who share your career interests and experiences.
Want more control over your experience? Subscribe to Clean Feed to remove ads from your feed and hide posts containing keywords you don’t want to see.

ANONYMOUS BY DESIGN

Blind separates your work verification from what you say and do on the platform, so you can verify where you work without attaching your identity to your activity.
Because of this separation, Blind cannot retrieve forgotten passwords. If you lose access, you may need to create a new account.
Rooted or jailbroken devices cannot access Blind. Please download Blind only from the official App Store.

https://us.teamblind.com/setting/privacy

• Pick a stage: HR, Technical or Behavioural

You open a tab. You open twelve more. An hour later, you've learned nothing you set out to — and the original idea is gone.

Dropt is for the curious. The ones who always meant to look something up. The ones who lose ideas every day to "I'll do it later."                                                                     

Later is now. Free to download

record.name: Deep Research
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Welcome to the Deep Research app

This app generates an extremely detailed summary along with the appropriate web links for any question of your choice. This can be anything related to politics, sports, a job search, or even a scientific query. While Google and CoPilot may satisfy our “on the go” searches when we need to look up a piece of information quickly, deep research serves a different purpose - it presents an extremely thorough and detailed summary. This is particularly useful for journalists, students, scientific or medical professionals, or professionals in just about ANY walk of life. 

The difference between using this app and using LLMs like GPT-5 directly is not just in the degree of detail. LLMs, however recent, do not have information about very recent events. Google and OpenAI have circumvented this difficulty by allowing these LLMs to do web searches, but, as you may have noticed, how the data from these web searches is used by these LLMs is not clear. The answers produced are, most of the time, sub-par and not what a professional would expect. Deep Research scraps each and every web page in its entirety using state-of-the-art web scrapers. This is followed by summary generation using state-of-the-art LLMs. The app processes nearly 1 million tokens with every search, which is almost equivalent to an entire textbook.

As you may expect, such a complex and extensive operation takes time. Most of the process occurs on our web servers, and after hitting “Run Job”, you can background or even close the app. You can open the app after about 10 minutes and check for progress. 

Please check out a brief video (in addition to reading this description thoroughly) before using the app. The video is available on the home screen once you open the app.

Note: the app uses OpenAI's API to generate some content. Per OpenAI, all content generated by the API is owned by the users. For more information, please visit:
https://openai.com/policies/services-agreement/

App privacy policy: https://bestmededuc.org/pp.pdf

The app provides 3 free searches.

MedDeep AI: AI Assistant for Licensed Healthcare Professionals

MedDeep AI is an advanced AI assistant built specifically for licensed healthcare professionals. It offers a suite of tools for retrieving medical knowledge, analyzing imaging, and generating insights across 40+ specialties. With support for image and PDF uploads plus enhanced vision capabilities, MedDeep AI brings powerful AI technology into a single pocket companion.

Powered by OpenAI’s GPT-4 and Vision API, MedDeep AI streamlines clinical workflows, improves efficiency, and ensures that professionals can access information while still relying on their own clinical expertise and authoritative sources.

Important Disclaimer

MedDeep AI is not a diagnostic platform, treatment system, or substitute for professional medical advice. It is designed solely for informational and educational purposes, exclusively for licensed healthcare professionals.

Users are reminded that:
Clinical judgment must always guide decision-making.
Information from MedDeep AI should be verified against authoritative medical sources.
The app is not intended for patient use, does not provide direct diagnoses, and is not cleared as a medical device.
All users must agree to these terms before proceeding. MedDeep AI is an assistant—never a replacement—for professional expertise.
AI Tools for Healthcare Professionals
MedDeep AI equips doctors with tailored assistants to quickly access trusted medical information, analyze images, and consult specialty-specific AI models.

Medical Knowledge Assistants: Support for lab results, drug interactions, clinical guidelines, prognostic outcomes, genomics, chronic disease management, and surgical risk assessment.

Medical Imaging Assistants: AI-powered observations for ECGs, X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, ultrasounds, mammograms, PET scans, skin lesions, histopathology slides, and microscopic images.

Specialty-Specific Assistants: Insights across cardiology, oncology, pediatrics, radiology, and many more fields—helping doctors get fast, relevant support.

Doctors can also upload medical images or PDFs for AI-enhanced review, making MedDeep AI a versatile partner in everyday clinical practice.

Why Choose MedDeep AI?
For licensed professionals only → ensures the right audience and use.
Powered by leading AI models → GPT-5 and Vision API deliver high-quality, accurate insights.
No patient data required → works without accounts or sensitive data.
Regularly updated → keeps doctors at the forefront of AI in medicine.
MedDeep AI simplifies access to essential medical insights while respecting professional expertise and user privacy.

Commitment to Privacy and Safety
MedDeep AI follows strict confidentiality standards:
No patient or personal data is collected, stored, or processed.
Every AI output reminds users to verify with trusted sources.
Doctors remain in full control of decision-making.
With MedDeep AI, healthcare professionals gain support to enhance their workflows while safeguarding privacy, accuracy, and trust.
